about: VCST-6191 live set (2026-10-07): every real ask logged on base main from 2026-10-06T00:00Z to f11d658 (62; synthetic lines excluded; 2 operator CLI replays removed, listed in removed[]). Candidates per question = verdict top 10 + floor-1 top 3 + BM25 top 8 over bodies (label-packets.mjs, seeds 1 and 2) on main@f11d658, the base the entries were labelled against. Labelled exhaustively by two independent Claude passes (48/60 agreed); the 12 disagreements adjudicated by a third. 59 targets (11 partial), 1 controls, 0 contested. Every row is split test. CAVEAT: the same sessions that asked these questions captured and confirmed entries on that day, so many targets are answered by entries written after the ask (the base caught up) -- this set measures choice among close entries, not coverage.
